reference_transcript.text: Hello. I saw your listing and I am interested in your car. However, I have a few questions.
Has it been in any major accidents?
No, I`ve kept it in very good condition.
All of the electronics are in working order, correct?
Yes, everything has been checked out recently.
Great! Would you take $10,000? 120k miles is kinda a lot.
I`m open to negotiate but 10k is a bit low. We could meet in the middle and say 13 000? I`ll include the extra speakers I recently purchased.
13,000 is fair, however I can only afford paying 12,500
Alright, I think that`s reasonable. We can agree on 12,500 then.

cognitive_style: I shift my view fairly easily — for a big purchase I ask many questions first, but once the answers satisfy me I am flexible on price: I will go above my initial number when the price is fair and the condition is right. Once I agree to a price, I keep my word.
